scripts.check: npm run contracts:check && npm run check -w @core-agent/runtime-core && npm run check -w @core-agent/control-plane-api && npm run check -w @core-agent/control-plane-worker && npm run check -w @core-agent/runtime-supervisor && npm run check -w @core-agent/control-plane-web
scripts.build:runtime-deps: npm run contracts:build && npm run build -w @core-agent/runtime-core
scripts.test:unit: npm run contracts:build && npm run test:runtime && npm run test -w @core-agent/contracts && npm run test -w @core-agent/runtime-core && npm test -w @core-agent/control-plane-web
scripts.test:postgres: npm run build:runtime-deps && npm run test:postgres -w @core-agent/runtime-core && npm run test:postgres -w @core-agent/control-plane-api
scripts.test:integration: npm run build:runtime-deps && node --import tsx --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/integration/provisioning.test.ts tests/integration/agent-run.test.ts tests/integration/recovery.test.ts tests/integration/security.test.ts
scripts.web:control-plane: npm run web:build && npm run start -w @core-agent/control-plane-web
